title: Langley drones were targeting NASA and a specific base location
place_text: Langley Air Force Base / NASA Langley, Virginia

tellings.quote: those drones were really targeting primarily NASA and then a very specific location on Langley Air Force Base

plain: A man named Dylan Borland, who worked at Langley Air Force Base in Virginia, says that in 2023 unexplained drones were flying over the area. He says they were mainly targeting NASA's Langley research center and one very specific spot on the air base, which would suggest whoever sent them knew exactly what they were looking for.
